title: carex nigra subsp. recta
intro: Carex nigra subsp. recta, commonly known as Black Sedge, is a type of sedge plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and alleviating respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Black Sedge include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which help to relieve coughs, calm muscle spasms, and reduce swelling. The bioactive constituents of Black Sedge include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
